name: PayPal AI Hackathon (Devpost)

eligibility.text: Age of majority where you live; teams and organisations allowed; excludes residents of Brazil, Quebec, Russia, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and other US-sanctioned countries
eligibility.quote: Individuals who are at least the age of majority where they reside as of the time of entry

summary: The single best current fit for an AI-assisted workflow: $67,500 pool, free entry confirmed, closes 2026-11-12, AI tools explicitly allowed and only a PayPal sandbox integration required.
flags: Prize is a pool total across categories; individual awards are smaller.
